card.name: Spots where "previously" could come next
card.fires_on: Small words or verbs in science news just before a new discovery or finding is described, where "previously unknown" or "previously unseen" would fit next. Typical words are "of", "a", "from" and "discovered".

modes.label: Discovery of new things
modes.description: Linking words after verbs or nouns of finding, right before "previously unknown".
modes.example: has led to the discovery of thousands<< of>> previously unknown galaxies.

modes.label: Novelty and unprecedented findings
modes.description: Words in news about new or never-before-seen results.
modes.example: helping humans extract resources<< from>> unprecedented depths

modes.label: Headline of new species
modes.description: Count words opening a headline about newly found species.
modes.example: <<Four>> new Brazilian species in the genus Ophi

card.writes: It pushes the model to write "previously" and its translations, and to avoid code-like tokens.
card.plain: It fires where a science story is about to say that something was previously unknown.
